messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] information about RHIPE (urgent)
parts:
On Thu, Jan 17, 2013 at 12:40 PM, <can.an...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

I would like to ask some questions regarding to RHIPE. 

What I want to do is implementing some data mining algorithms with R (possibly using RHIPE or Hadoop Streaming ) into Hadoop framework as a map/reduce job. 

My questions are : If I user RHIPE , map reduce functions will implemented with R , right ? And If I use HADOOP Streaming way , the map reduce functions will be implemented with JAVA , but the data mining algorithms will be with R. ? 


Everything you do will be in R. Though you can call out Java functions using rJava, you can write custom InputFormats, though you might not need it.


 
Actually I want to use only R for the implementation both map/reduce functions and to implement data mining algorithms. How Can I do that ? 

RHIPE is all R.

 

And other question is , if I implement a data mining algorithm with R such as knn or kmeans without hadoop framework, can I use that code to RHIPE in Hadoop ? 



You can code it in RHIPE

 
I am looking forward to your answers

Best Regards
Can
